method: Empirical scenario targets derived from observed cell-level Ookla performance. These are hypothetical what-if targets, not regulatory service standards.

typical_observed.label: Typical Observed Target
typical_observed.description: Hypothetical connectivity outcome based on approximately median observed performance across measured Kuala Selangor cells.

strong_observed.label: Strong Observed Target
strong_observed.description: Hypothetical stronger connectivity outcome using upper-quartile observed speeds and lower-quartile observed latency.

top_observed.label: Top Observed Target
top_observed.description: Hypothetical high-performance connectivity outcome using P90 observed speeds and P10 observed latency.
